citations.claim: initial total energy before any bouncing
energy has grown close to the limit after many elastic bounces
first violation: energy exceeds E0*1.1+5 despite no controller work

explanation: Elastic ball (e=1) bouncing on floor under gravity with large dt=1/30 steadily gains mechanical energy: from 6600 J initially to ~7246 J at step 700 to 7265.3 J at step 720, exceeding allowed 7265 J with zero controller work. Likely cause is energy injection by impulse plus positional correction at each floor contact combined with semi-implicit Euler / substep integration error, accumulating over hundreds of bounces instead of conserving energy.
vision_note: The single ball keeps bouncing normally with no visible wall penetration, tunneling, or exit from the arena. It rises slightly from step 717 to 719 and then is low again at step 720, showing a continuous bounce cycle with no dramatic glitch.
